objectives.text: Write INSERT statements that add one or several rows with the column list named explicitly
Write UPDATE and DELETE statements whose WHERE clause changes only the intended rows, previewing them with SELECT first
Use RETURNING to see the rows an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE changed

The module PR replaces both modeled values with the estimator P50 and the modeled worst required route of the authored page and raises the budget if the honest minimum is higher; it never compresses it.
